DPDP-SAFEGUARDS.summary: Take reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

DPDP-BREACH.summary: Intimate the Data Protection Board and affected persons without delay; detailed report within 72 hours.

DPDP-PURPOSE.summary: Process personal data only for the purpose the person consented to.

RBI-CYBER.regulation: RBI IT governance and cyber security directions for NBFCs
RBI-CYBER.summary: Elevated access is supervised, logged and reviewed; MFA for privileged users; report cyber incidents to RBI within 6 hours.

RBI-DL.summary: Need-based use of borrower data with consent and audit trail; disbursal only into the borrower's own bank account; lender stays responsible for its lending service providers.

CERTIN.summary: Report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours; keep ICT logs for 180 days in India.
